items.title: Vince Giordano interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And some fellow named John Schoup. ... [INTERVIEWEE] John Schoup.

ctx.x: And some fellow named John Schoup. © Fillius Jazz Archive -10-

He had something to do with, oh I won’t be able to think of it now, but I hope to attend and see what they have to say, because what’s sort of ironic about it, if you look at the huge schedule of what goes on here, there’s not much trad jazz to be found. Not only in the bands they have playing but also any other forums they’re talking about. So I’m not sure what that means. But I don’t think people, they have a harder time teaching people to play that because it’s not codified as much you know. Like gee we can’t…
